== Source ==
Still at 5:10 from [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pUtpV-lmJoo&t=310 MPC 2019 Interviews: Danny Lamar], Star Wars CCG (Players Committee YouTube, 27 April 2019). The title names Danny Lamar. The interviewer says he is sitting with Colorado's Danny Lamar. Still: Players Committee. No Wayback capture of this watch URL as of 19 November 2026.

== File details ==
